aggressor_flag_calibration.labels: Calibrates the isAggressor assumption that every venue_order_id_not_ours verdict depends on, against rows already known to be ours by client order id. Counts only.
aggressor_flag_calibration.verdict: NOT_CALIBRATED: no row was both known-ours by client order id and resolvable by venue order id, so every `venue_order_id_not_ours` verdict in this audit rests on an UNVERIFIED reading of isAggressor and must be read as unresolved rather than as external activity

deferred_job.labels: ran off the window-roll path, after every trading stage in the tick
deferred_job.name: cost_basis_audit

execution_field_inventory.labels: DIAGNOSTIC. Names the keys the nested execution objects carry so side and commission are READ off the feed, not guessed. Field NAMES and side-like VALUES only.

fee_and_notional_evidence.labels: EVIDENCE, not assumption. A credited maker rebate is a NEGATIVE commission; a zero commission is NOT a rebate. rebates_ever_credited false means no pair whose profitability depends on the rebate has been proven on this account. smallest_executed_notional_usd is the closest available evidence of the venue's minimum order VALUE, which this codebase reads nowhere -- it bounds the smallest configuration from below. Aggregates only; no identifier is reported.

labels: READ-ONLY evidence. overstatement_usd is how much the $1/share placeholders exceed the measured cost on the legs that could be established -- it is NOT a correction and has NOT been applied. Applying it would move realized toward zero, which correct_settled_market refuses as CORRECTION_WOULD_RELAX_LOSS_HALT and which needs its own owner decision.
